description: This Java file defines a servlet class 'AddCategory' that handles POST requests to add a new category in an online grocery ordering system. It processes form data, interacts with a database utility class to insert a new category, and manages the response depending on success or failure.

classes.name: AddCategory
classes.description: A servlet class that handles adding a new category by processing form data, interacting with the database, and directing the response accordingly.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to add a new category, including retrieving form parameters, calling database utility methods, managing session and request attributes, and redirecting or forwarding based on success.
